response.sql: WITH telescope_averages AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), status_averages AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate FROM telescope_averages GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate FROM status_averages), kept_statuses AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.avg_pulse_rate, sa.avg_pulse_rate - fm.mean_pulse_rate AS excess_first FROM status_averages AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.avg_pulse_rate > fm.mean_pulse_rate), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse_rate) AS mean_pulse_rate FROM kept_statuses) SELECT AVG(ks.avg_pulse_rate) AS avg_pulse_rate, AVG(ks.excess_first) AS avg_excess_first, AVG(ks.avg_pulse_rate - sm.mean_pulse_rate) AS avg_excess_second FROM kept_statuses AS ks CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE ks.avg_pulse_rate > sm.mean_pulse_rate;
